exhibits.name: Jacquard Loom
exhibits.summary: A loom that takes its pattern from a chain of punched cards: same cards, same cloth, every time. The ancestor of the stored program.

exhibits.name: Felt Comptometer
exhibits.summary: Dorr E. Felt's key-driven mechanical calculator: prototype 1885, first practical machine 1886, patents 1887. The first commercially successful key-driven calculator, in production into the mid-1970s.

exhibits.name: WITCH (Harwell Dekatron)
exhibits.summary: The Harwell Dekatron computer, operational from 1951. It stores numbers in dekatron counting tubes and holds the record for the most hours of unattended operation for a working computer.
